name: What happens if hidden damage is discovered during the demolition phase?

mainEntity.name: What happens if hidden damage is discovered during the demolition phase?

acceptedAnswer.text: Older properties across Denver, Littleton, and Englewood frequently uncover vintage framing quirks, non-grounded wiring, unvented plumbing, or aging plaster and drywall that deteriorate once walls are opened. When an unexpected issue is discovered, an experienced contractor pauses work on that section, inspects the condition with you, and explains practical repair options before moving forward. HH Remodeling coordinates necessary trade repairs for wiring and piping while adjusting framing or drywall plans directly on site. Maintaining a contingency fund of ten to fifteen percent in your budget ensures that unforeseen structural or utility repairs do not derail your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Your contractor assesses the issue with you, provides repair solutions, and coordinates trade repairs before continuing finish work. A 10% to 15% contingency fund handles these surprises.
